name: 47408 · Bloomington, IN
findings: ZIP 47408 (Bloomington) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47408 (Bloomington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 47408 (Bloomington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
